title: Phone Payment Fee and the Size of the Payment — Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Worked Examples
content:
**Rule.** The size of the named payment decides how the phone payment fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account is charged, measured against the scheduled monthly payment (the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent, never below the plan's minimum monthly payment): a payment smaller than the scheduled monthly payment is charged the lower of the fee and the small-payment share of 3% of the payment, rounded to the cent; a payment of at least twice the scheduled monthly payment is charged the higher of the fee and the large-payment share of 0.5% of the payment, rounded to the cent; any other payment is charged the fee as a flat amount.

The named payment is the amount of the most recent payment taken through a phone agent. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

## Size bands

| Named payment against the scheduled monthly payment | Charged |
|---|---|
| Smaller than the scheduled monthly payment | The lower of the fee and 3% of the payment |
| From the scheduled monthly payment up to just under twice it | The fee, flat |
| Twice the scheduled monthly payment or more | The higher of the fee and 0.5% of the payment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, scheduled monthly payment 450.00, fee 7.00)

| Named payment | Band | Figure compared | Charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 150.00 | Smaller | 3% of 150.00 is 4.50 | 4.50 |
| 449.99 | Smaller | 3% of 449.99 is 13.4997, so 13.50 | 7.00 |
| 450.00 | Flat | — | 7.00 |
| 899.99 | Flat | — | 7.00 |
| 900.00 | Twice or more | 0.5% of 900.00 is 4.50 | 7.00 |
| 1500.00 | Twice or more | 0.5% of 1500.00 is 7.50 | 7.50 |
